نَضَحٌ and ↓ نَضِيحٌ (tropical:) A watering-trough or tank; or so called because it moistens [or allays] the thirst of camels: (IAar, S:) or a small watering-trough or tank: (TA:) or the latter a watering-trough or tank that is near to the well, so as to be filled with the bucket; and it may be large: (Lth:) pl. of the former أَنْضَاحٌ; and of the latter نُضُحٌ. (S.) ―
-b2- نَضَحُ الوُضُوْءِ What is sprinkled in the performance of the ablution called الوضوء. (L.) [See نَضَحَ فَرْجَهُ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
